name: Schema.org/DigitalDocument
description: Adds Schema.org DigitalDocument (and Note/Presentation/Spreadsheet/Text subtypes) JSON-LD output via the Schema.org Metatag framework.
project_description:
This module provides the following Schema.org types:

 
 schema.org/DigitalDocument 
 schema.org/NoteDigitalDocument 
 schema.org/PresentationDigitalDocument 
 schema.org/SpreadsheetDigitalDocument 
 schema.org/TextDigitalDocument 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Schema.org Metatag module 2.x or higher. 
 
 Usage 
 
 Enable the schema_digital_document module. 
 Go to Administration > Configuration > Search and metadata > Metatag ( /admin/config/search/metatag ) and click the button "Add default meta tags". 
 Select your entity type and bundle, expand the " Schema.org: DigitalDocument" fieldset and fill in the field mappings you want to publish.
